Add structural/fault-injection and bounded native proofs without raw-PID target authority.

JOB-AC-3.evidence: Failure cleanup, bounded helper teardown, identity checks, EOF handling, and Job-handle termination are implemented.

JOB-AC-4.evidence: Raw-PID custody is refused when native Job custody is unavailable; Linux behavior remains separate.
